caption_used: 该折线图展示了lattice、FLAT与OURS三种方法在训练过程中F1分数的演变趋势。横轴为训练轮数（epoch），范围从0到18；纵轴为F1分数，范围从0.55至0.90。红色实线带方形标记代表lattice方法，初始F1值约为0.59，在epoch=16时达到约0.85。蓝色实线带圆形标记代表FLAT方法，起始F1值约为0.79，收敛速度较快。黄色实线带三角形标记代表OURS方法，初始F1值约为0.82，最终在epoch=16达到约0.90。值得注意的是，FLAT方法在epoch=8附近即超越OURS，两者在中间阶段表现接近，而lattice方法虽起步较慢但在后期展现出与FLAT相当的增长速率。
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This line chart illustrates the evolution of F1 scores for three methods—lattice, FLAT, and OURS—during training. The x-axis represents the number of training epochs, ranging from 0 to 18, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents the F1 score, ranging from 0.55 to 0.90, with major gridlines at 0.05 intervals. The red solid line with square markers corresponds to the lattice method, starting at an F1 score of approximately 0.59 at epoch 2 and increasing to about 0.85 at epoch 16. The blue solid line with circular markers represents the FLAT method, beginning at an F1 score of around 0.79 at epoch 2 and rising to approximately 0.88 at epoch 16. The yellow solid line with triangular markers corresponds to the OURS method, starting at an F1 score of about 0.82 at epoch 2 and reaching approximately 0.90 at epoch 16. All three lines show an increasing trend, with the lattice method exhibiting a steeper growth rate in the later epochs compared to its initial phase.
